async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Home' link to navigate to the GitLab dashboard
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Home').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Use the knowledge base function to navigate to the project details page
    await navigate_to_project_details(page, 'Byte Blaze / gimmiethat.space')
    
    # Navigate to the project settings general page
    await page.goto('/byteblaze/gimmiethat.space/-/settings/general')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Find the input field for the project name and fill it with the new title
    name_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Project name')
    await name_input.fill('Welcome to my site')
    
    # Find and click the save button
    save_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save changes')
    await save_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
